entry.content: arXiv:2609.15548v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Botto is often described as a decentralized autonomous artist, but its authorship cannot be located in image generation alone. entry.title: Alignment Hierarchy
entry.content: there is no outside-text Jacques Derrida Suppose a model is aligned. The common context structure forms a hierarchy of authority: weights, system prompt, and user messages.
